title: Iman vs Ihsan: Farq Kya Hai?
script: Deen ka sabse aala maqam konsa hai... jab aap Allah ko dekh rahe ho? Iman dil se yaqeen aur ghaib par tasdeeq ka naam hai. Jabke Ihsan ibadat ka wo aala meyaar hai jaise aap Allah ko dekh rahe ho. Iman yaqeen ki bunyad hai, jabke Ihsan ibadat ka husn aur kamal. Aise hi Islamic comparisons ke liye follow karein.
hook_variants: Deen ka sabse aala maqam konsa hai... jab aap Allah ko dekh rahe ho?
Kya aapko Iman aur Ihsan mein farq pata hai?
Iman aur Ihsan ko ek samajhne ki ghalti mat karein!
